titleEn: Royal Decree on the Establishment of the Council for Legal and Judicial Reform

articles.en: The provisions of Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0602/158 dated 19 June 2002 on the establishment of the Council for Legal and Judicial Reform are hereby amended as follows:

New provision: the Council for Legal and Judicial Reform is hereby established to fulfil the mission of the Supreme Council for Reform in the legal and judicial sector, with the following composition: - Deputy Prime Minister, Minister in charge of the Office of the Council of Ministers, Co-Chair; - President of the Supreme Court, Co-Chair; - Minister of Justice, Vice-Chair; - President of the Cambodian Human Rights Committee and President of the Anti-Corruption Unit, Vice-Chair; - President of the Court of Appeal, Vice-Chair; - President of the Phnom Penh Municipal Court, member; - Representative of the Bar Association, 01 person, member; - Secretary of State of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, 01 person, member; - Secretary of State of the Office of the Council of Ministers, 01 person, member; - Secretary of State of the Ministry of Interior, 01 person, member; - Secretary of State of the Ministry of Commerce, 01 person, member; - Secretary-General of the Council for Legal and Judicial Reform, permanent member.
The appointment of the members of the Council for Legal and Judicial Reform shall be determined by a separate Royal Decree.

New provision: the Council for Legal and Judicial Reform shall have a General Secretariat as its support body.
The General Secretariat of the Council for Legal and Judicial Reform shall be led by one Secretary-General, assisted by a number of Deputy Secretaries-General as necessary.
The Secretary-General and the Deputy Secretaries-General shall be appointed by Royal Decree.
The organisation and functioning of the General Secretariat of the Council for Legal and Judicial Reform shall be determined by sub-decree.
Article 2.
Any provisions the content of which is contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.
Article 3.
Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall implement this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
Done at Phnom Penh, 27 March 2009, in the Royal name and by Royal command; Acting Head of State, signature and Royal seal; Samdech Moha Thomma Pothisal Chea Sim, having respectfully submitted to the King of the Kingdom of Cambodia for signature; Prime Minister, signature, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen; No. 325 Ch.L.; certified true copy for distribution, Phnom Penh, 02 April 2009, Deputy Secretary-General of the Royal Government, Khun Chin Phen.
